summary: Frontend-only regression test of admin login redirect-loop fix. All 5 target flows PASS: (1) /admin/login loads without redirecting when unauthenticated (GET /api/auth/me returns 401, page stays put). (2) Admin login with admin@nicnackables.com / NicNack2024! -> POST /api/auth/login 200 -> POST/GET /api/auth/me 200 -> redirected to /admin dashboard, dashboard data loaded (orders/menu/testimonials/contacts). (3) After landing on /admin, URL remains /admin over 8s of observation (no redirect loop). (4) Direct navigation to /admin while authenticated stays on /admin. (5) Logout button hits /api/auth/logout 200 and redirects back to /admin/login. (6) Non-admin login (test.customer@example.com/test1234) -> POST /api/auth/login 200 but ProtectedRoute/AdminLogin correctly blocks: user stays on /admin/login and sees error 'This account does not have admin access. Please use an admin account.' No /api/api/auth/me duplication observed in network log. Fix verified.

issues: Error banner uses red text on dark red background - readable but could improve contrast. Also the alert div does not use standard .error / role=alert class so error-selector queries return empty (minor testability nit).

passed_tests: GET /admin/login renders form when unauthenticated (no redirect loop)
Admin redirected to /admin after login and stays there (no loop)
Direct GET /admin while authenticated stays on /admin
Non-admin login blocked at /admin/login with explicit 'not admin access' message
action_items: Optional: add role="alert" or class="error" to the AdminLogin error banner div for better testability/accessibility (currently plain div text - selector queries for .error/[role=alert] return empty).
Note: /register default-mode bug from iteration_11 is unrelated to this fix and still outstanding.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix looks correct: ProtectedRoute and AdminLogin.checkAuth/handleEmailLogin now consistently use BACKEND_URL + /api/auth/me and gate on is_admin. Verified via network trace - only /api/auth/me (single /api) is called.

AdminLogin: consider clearing cookies / calling /api/auth/logout when denying a non-admin who successfully authenticated, otherwise the customer session cookie remains active and the user is silently logged in as customer if they navigate elsewhere.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@nicnackables.com / NicNack2024! (verified). Non-admin: test.customer@example.com / test1234 (verified - authenticates but blocked from admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin redirect-loop is fully fixed. Only follow-up: (1) unrelated /register default-mode bug (see iteration_11), (2) consider auto-logout when a non-admin is denied at /admin/login so their customer cookie doesn't linger.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was double /api prefixing: API constant already included /api, so calling `${API}/auth/me` produced /api/api/auth/me -> 404/401, ProtectedRoute treated the user as unauthenticated and bounced to /admin/login; AdminLogin's checkAuth then saw a valid session cookie and redirected back to /admin, creating a loop. Additionally, is_admin was not being enforced. Fix (verified): ProtectedRoute and AdminLogin now use `${BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/me` and explicitly check user.is_admin before granting/redirecting. Verified in network trace - only single-prefixed /api/auth/me appears.
